summary: A design bundle for what Nora should keep track of between turns, and why she currently keeps track of nothing.
details: She is measurably good at not interrupting and measurably unable to act on her own: the numbers, and why they are the doctrine working exactly as written rather than a tuning problem.

Four situations from real groups that the current design has no shape for — a dinner nobody planned, a game the group re-argues from scratch every time, a suggestion with no occasion behind it, and a friend's injury worth asking after.
What a note would have to become to hold them: something that is live rather than something that is undecided, with a record of when it last moved and when it stops being true.
The order the changes have to land in, what each one risks, and the one decision that has to be made first because everything else is overruled without it.
No behaviour changes. This is a proposal.
